title: Equality of the two ordinary finite scalar pullback presentations
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, schemes X,Y, a morphism f:X→Y and n≥0. For an ordinary completed module M on Y, let αX,αY be the ordinary scalar presentations of [lem-sf-finite-scalar-ordinary-reduction-iso], let q=scalarPullModule(reduction to exponent n+1,f), and let G be ringed geometric pullback for the finite coefficient sheaves. Then q.inv_M followed by G(αY.hom_M) and finitePullbackIso(f,n).hom_(scalarExt(Y,n)(M)) equals αX.hom_(completedPull(f)(M)), followed by ordinaryFiniteScalarPull(f,n).hom_M and pullbackTensorLevelIntrinsic(f,n).hom_(scalarExt(Y,n)(M)). This is a statement solely about ordinary module adjunctions; there is no derived object, coefficient sequence, or realization model.

source.place: The scalar/pullback comparison on a flat-term K-flat representative in the finite-evaluation argument; Stacks Tags 07A6, 06YY and 0D6E.

proof.text: Transpose the two ordinary composites through the completed geometric and finite scalar adjunctions. Transfer scalar transposes through the leftAdjointUniq scalar presentations. Transfer the finite geometric transpose through finiteDirectImage_eq and the finitePullbackIso uniqueness map. The unit formula that uniquely defines pullbackTensorLevelIntrinsic identifies it with the corresponding uniqueness map. The resulting restriction/direct-image comparison is finiteScalarRestrictionDirect on both sides. Injectivity of the Hom equivalence proves the equality; this is an ordinary module calculation with no derived or realization data. The formal combination is adjunctionSquareTransport. Uniqueness of the normalized intrinsic comparison identifies it with leftAdjointUniq; leftAdjointUniq_trans_app then factors the finite geometric presentation through the level one.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteScalarPullPresentation {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    (M : integralTowerModules l E Y) :
    (PurCompactSupport.scalarPullModule
        (PurCompactSupport.reduction l E (n + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)) f).inv.app M ≫
      (proEtaleRingModulePullback f
        ((PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)).ring Y)
        ((PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)).ring X)
        ((PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)).pull f)).map
          ((finiteScalarOrdinaryReductionIso l E Y n).hom.app M) ≫
      (PurCompactSupport.finitePullbackIso l E n f).hom.app
        ((scalarReductionExtension l E Y n).obj M) =
    (finiteScalarOrdinaryReductionIso l E X n).hom.app
        ((integralOrdinaryPull l E f).obj M) ≫
      (ordinaryFiniteScalarPull l E f n).hom.app M ≫
      (pullbackTensorLevelIntrinsic l E f n).hom.app
        ((scalarReductionExtension l E Y n).obj M)
